question: Where can I find a golf course within 60 kilometers of J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name AS name FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 60000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 60000);

answers.park_name: King's Grant Golf and Country Club
